hero.title: Extensions for physics agents
hero.subtitle: Packaged physics tools, agent skills, and a research-level physics benchmark. Every extension reports its performance on the benchmark subset of its own field.

tools.title: Tools
tools.body: Physics toolkits exposed as MCP servers, shipped either as code with a deployment program or as a prebuilt container.

skills.title: Skills
skills.body: Agent skills kept in this repository, each labeled with its field and measured on that field's benchmark subset.

benchmark.title: Benchmark
benchmark.body: Research-level physics tasks, each packaged as a container and reviewed by a physicist. One runner drives every sample by id and parameters.

harness.title: Official harness
harness.body: An evaluation harness built on the current DeepSeek harness release. Optional — any harness can run the benchmark.

tools.title: Tools
tools.body: Primary category, delivery form and measured performance of every tool.

skills.title: Skills
skills.body: Primary category and measured performance of every skill.

benchmark.title: Benchmark
benchmark.body: Sample list, reviewer titles and evaluation results are hosted on Hugging Face as CSV; sample containers are hosted on the GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io).

footer.text: Code, documentation and data are maintained in the GitHub repository.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.body: How far the skills, tools and benchmark samples reach across physics, counted by domain of the HP4PS taxonomy.

results.title: Applications
results.body: Research outcomes reached with HP4PS extensions.
